name: media_merge
description: Join several videos (or audio files) end to end into one file, in the order given. In auto mode, files with identical formats are joined instantly without re-encoding; otherwise every clip is scaled and padded to the same size and frame rate, missing audio is filled with silence, and the result is re-encoded. Use width/height/fps to choose the output format.

inputs.description: Files to join, in order (2–200), relative to the workspace.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format; default is the first input's format. Default: next to the input as <name>_merged.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

mode.description: auto (default), fast (only identical formats) or reencode.

width.description: Output width when re-encoding. Default: the first video's.

height.description: Output height when re-encoding. Default: the first video's.

fps.description: Output frame rate when re-encoding. Default: the first video's.

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
